BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing horse racing handicapping contestsfor patrons of a class 1 racing association live race meet; and addinga new section to chapter 67.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature hereby authorizes class 1 racing associations toconduct horse race handicapping contests. The commission shallestablish rules for the conduct of handicapping contests involving theoutcome of multiple horse races.
